rule.description: The glTF cross-reference translation between JSON object indices and the object pointers owned by cgltf_data must live in one consolidated definition per lifecycle stage; hand-written copies of that arithmetic inside ordinary function bodies are scattered fragments of the same responsibility.

checks.description: Detect parse functions that stage a JSON object index as a biased pseudo-pointer with hand-written arithmetic instead of one consolidated staging definition.
checks.detected_relation: JSON object index -> staged pseudo-pointer (index + 1 bias), spelled inline in a parse-function body
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Every parse site re-implements the same half of the cross-reference translation, so parsing, fixing up, and re-serializing the same relationship requires editing many separate function bodies.

excluded.pattern: pointer-difference fragments whose spelling location is a macro definition body (e.g. the texture-info write macros in cgltf_write.h)
excluded.reason: Tokens spelled inside a macro definition belong to that one consolidated definition; preprocessor expansion copies the spelling location, not the intent. Rewriting those call sites as macro bodies is a valid consolidation, so they must not count as scattered fragments.

excluded.pattern: cgltf_accessor_index / cgltf_buffer_index / cgltf_buffer_view_index / cgltf_mesh_index / cgltf_node_index / cgltf_material_index / cgltf_image_index / cgltf_texture_index / cgltf_sampler_index / cgltf_skin_index / cgltf_camera_index / cgltf_light_index / cgltf_scene_index and the other public cgltf_*_index helpers in cgltf.h
excluded.reason: Those public helpers consume the pointer difference as an unsigned cgltf_size return value, not as a signed writer index; they are an existing partial consolidation of a different (size-typed) relation, kept intact.

excluded.pattern: integer-minus-one arithmetic whose operands are not both pointers (e.g. base64 or byte-offset decoding), and pointer differences consumed through pointer-typed parameters (e.g. strchr-style scanning)
excluded.reason: The rule matches the reference-translation relation between an object pointer and the arrays owned by cgltf_data; plain integer offset arithmetic and pointer-parameter searching do not participate.
